Clean the surfaces of your CPU or GPU and heatsink thoroughly, then add a small amount of the paste to the centre of the component. Once you secure the cooler, the paste will spread evenly, creating a perfect thermal seal. This simple thermal paste application ensures your system operates at peak performance without overheating. item.title: eSun HIPS - Natural - 1.75 - 1kg Filament
item.description: Please Note: eSun has recently changed their filament spool material. You may receive a cardboard spool, instead of the plastic spools depicted above. This move means a more environmentally friendly design to their 3D filament spools which comfortably sit on your 3D printer's standard spool holder for smooth filament feeding. These 1kg rolls of Natural eSUN HIPS 1.75mm filament are made from a very unique plastic known as High Impact Polystyrene. Despite the common perception of polystyrene, this material is infused with strong impact-resistant properties, making it both an easy and durable material to print with. Some of the main features of this plastic is that it is highly resistant to impact, as well as resistant to warping during the printing process, while being dissolvable with Limonene solvent. These features make it great for printing parts or objects that may be exposed to high impact, but also as dissolvable struts and supports for other materials during prints. The reason why some 3D Makers choose HIPS Filament over ABS Filament is because of the reduced sagging, as it caters to some of common problems with overhangs. Additionally, it offers similar printing characteristics and temperature requirements as ABS, meaning that it’s easy to learn to print with if you are already experienced in ABS printing. PRINTING SPECIFICATIONS: Print Temp – 220° - 260°C Bed Temp – 110°C Density (g/cm 3 ) – 1.05 Distortion Temp (C,0.45MPa) – 80 Melt Flow Index (g/10min) – 3 (200°C/5kg) Tensile Strength (MPa) – 27 Elongation at Break (%) – 55 Bending Strength (MPa) – 39 IZOD Impact Strength (kJ) – 11 TYPICAL APPLICATIONS FOR NATURAL HIPS 1.75MM 1KG ESUN: These 1kg rolls of 1.75mm Natural HIPS Filament from eSUN are most commonly purchased as an alternative to ABS filament, as it offers many of the unique properties of ABS but with a few extra benefits. Not only is it warp-resistant, but can also be dissolved or finely polished with limonene solvent. This, in the hands of a veteran 3D Maker, is the ideal combination of features to produce amazing results. Additionally, HIPS is an excellent choice for dual-extruder setups to build struts and supports for plastics that are prone to sagging on overhangs, which can then be easily removed without damaging the prints which they are supporting. The similar temperature requirements also mean that you don’t even need to change the settings if you are printing this alongside ABS, as they share very similar printing characteristics and requirements.

item.title: Mini-Mag Magnetic Tile Tracks with 2 Cars 93 Pieces
item.description: Ignite your child’s imagination with a magnetic track set that lets them build, design, and race their own creations ! The Edu-Matic Mini-Mag Set blends hands-on construction, open-ended storytelling, and early STEM learning into one exciting 93-piece kit. Kids can snap together 37 track sections and 20 magnetic tiles to create a bustling cityscape, then send two speedy cars zooming around the routes they’ve engineered. item.title: Creality K2 PRO Combo 3D Printer – High-Speed CoreXY with CFS Multicolor System and AI Cameras (300×300×300 mm)
item.description: Creality K2 PRO Combo 3D Printer with CFS – High-Speed CoreXY Multicolor FDM Printer with AI Cameras, Auto Leveling, and Enclosed Chamber (300×300×300 mm) The Creality K2 PRO Combo is a professional-grade FDM 3D printer designed for multicolor, high-speed, and precision printing. The included CFS (Creality Filament System) enables automatic filament switching for up to four colors (expandable to sixteen), making it ideal for complex, multi-material prints. item.title: Creality Halot Mage 8K Resin 3D Printer
item.description: Creality Halot Mage 8K Resin 3D Printer The Halot Mage 8K is Creality’s flagship resin printer, engineered for ultra-high precision and large-format resin printing. With its 8K monochrome LCD, advanced integral light source, and smart features like air purification and resin pumping, it delivers professional-grade results for hobbyists, designers, and manufacturers alike. activated carbon filter (5.8× larger than standard) absorbs resin fumes, with rear vent port for tubing Smart Resin Pump – automatic resin refill and recovery for clean, hands-free operation Air Purifier – integrated system for a safer, fresher workspace Wide Software Compatibility – supports HALOT BOX, CHITUBOX, Lychee Slicer, and Voxeldance Tango Free Chitubox Pro Trial – 3-month VIP license included for advanced slicing options Specifications Printing Technology: MSLA (Masked Stereolithography) Build Volume: 228 × 128 × 230 mm (6712 cm³) Printing Speed: ≤170 mm/h Layer Height: 0.05 – 0.15 mm LCD Screen: 10.3” monochrome LCD Resolution: 8K (7680 × 4320) XY Resolution: 29.7 μm Light Source: Integral Light Source 3.0 Light Uniformity: >90% Light Intensity: 8000 ±10% μW/cm² Release Film: High-speed film File Transfer: USB drive, RJ45 cable, WiFi, Creality Cloud Smart Resin Pump: Yes Air Purifier: Yes Input Power: 150W Slicing Software: HALOT BOX, CHITUBOX, Lychee Slicer, Voxeldance Tango Computer OS: Windows / Mac File Formats: STL / OBJ Display Screen: 4.3” color touchscreen Product Dimensions: 333 × 270 × 608 mm Highlights Ultra-high detail with 8K resolution for professional-grade models Large build volume for bigger projects or batch printing Faster curing times with uniform light source technology Stable Z-axis for precision on tall or heavy prints Safe and convenient with UV-blocking lid and odor filtration Smart automation with resin pump and air purifier Flexible slicing software support for different workflows The Creality Halot Mage 8K is a powerful resin printer that combines large-format capacity, ultra-fine detail, and smart convenience features . It’s perfect for miniatures, prototypes, jewelry, dental models, and professional design work .

item.title: Panchroma Basic PLA Magenta- 1.75mm 1kg
item.description: PLA (Polylactic Acid) is a durable and easy-to-use thermoplastic, ideal for 3D printing. It is a biodegradable polymer that delivers excellent print quality. This filament features a 1.75 mm diameter, ensuring universal compatibility with FDM printers while providing high-precision prints with excellent dimensional tolerance. A Next-Generation Formula Built for Speed Panchroma™ PLA features an advanced formulation engineered for high-speed printing, supporting volumetric speeds of up to 28 mm/s and print speeds of up to 350 mm/s. Achieve precise parts with smooth surfaces while significantly reducing production time. Designed to Bring Your Ideas to Life Perfect for miniatures, cosplay props, prototypes, models, and decorative pieces, this filament ensures outstanding detail and a refined finish. Whether for display pieces or functional projects, results are consistently clean, sharp, and professional. Smooth, Reliable Printing Experience Thanks to high-quality winding, the risk of tangling is eliminated from the start. Its optimized formulation also reduces swelling and clogging in the extruder, ensuring stable, reliable printing—even during long print jobs. Vibrant and Consistent Colors With 28 rich and uniform colors, Panchroma™ PLA enhances every creation. From bold tones to subtle shades, the smooth finish delivers clean, polished results straight off the printer. Easy to Use, Broad Compatibility Compatible with most FDM/FFF 3D printers, this filament is easy to use with minimal setup. Its strong bed adhesion and stable cooling behavior make it a versatile material suitable for users of all skill levels. Key Benefits Easy to print Ultra-high printing speed Strong bed adhesion and stable performance Smooth finish and precise details Considerations Limited heat resistance (may deform from ~60°C) Sensitive to UV exposure and long-term temperature variations Physical Properties Description Typical Value Bed Temperature 25-60°C Print Speed 350mm/s Printing Temp. 190/230°C

item.title: Xiaomi Smart Doorbell 3S
item.description: The Xiaomi Smart Doorbell 3S enhances home security with its ultra-wide camera and 2K resolution, offering clear and detailed visuals of visitors and surroundings. With a 107° vertical viewing angle, it ensures a panoramic view of your doorstep, capturing essential details for comprehensive monitoring. The advanced night vision mode, powered by six 940nm infrared illuminators, automatically activates in low-light conditions, allowing you to see clearly even in complete darkness. Whether day or night, the Xiaomi Smart Doorbell 3S keeps you informed and in control of your home’s security. Designed for durability, the Xiaomi Smart Doorbell 3S boasts an IP65 water and dust resistance rating, ensuring stable performance in various weather conditions. Its dual power supply options, either a built-in 5200mAh lithium battery or a hardwired connection, offer flexibility based on your installation preference. The Type-C charging port allows for faster, more convenient charging, reducing the need for frequent battery replacements. This combination of reliability and convenience ensures uninterrupted security monitoring. Equipped with AI-powered human shape detection and a built-in motion sensor, the Xiaomi Smart Doorbell 3S monitors your doorstep 24/7, alerting you instantly to any unusual activity. You can customise the detection area to receive only relevant notifications and access recorded videos from the past 72 hours without a subscription. The integrated Xiaomi Security Chip safeguards against video leaks, device forgery, and unauthorized access, providing a secure and private monitoring experience. With smart features like two-way audio communication, integration with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant, and a dedicated indoor chime with adjustable volume settings, the Xiaomi Smart Doorbell 3S offers a seamless user experience. You can even set up a personalized welcome message for visitors or enable “Do Not Disturb” mode when needed. Its Wi-Fi 6 connectivity ensures fast and stable video streaming, keeping you connected to your home at all times. Whether for convenience, security, or smart home integration, the Xiaomi Smart Doorbell 3S is a versatile and reliable addition to any household. FEATURES: Built-in security camera Ultra clear 2K resolution IP65 waterproof Dedicated indoor chime 5200mAh (typ) battery Xiaomi security chip Two power supply modes SPECIFICATIONS: Doorbell IP Rating: IP65 Battery Capacity: 5200mAh (typ) Rated Input: 5V⎓2A (Type-C port); 8-24VAC, 10-40VA, 50–60Hz (doorbell AC transformer) Wireless Connectivity: Wi-Fi IEEE 802.11b/g/n 2.4GHz, RF 433MHz Infrared Light: 940 nm infrared light Audio System: Two-way voice calls Storage: Cloud storage Charging Temperature: 0℃ to 45℃ Operating Temperature: -20℃ to 50℃ Operating Humidity: 10%-90% RH, non-condensing External Dimensions: 146 × 52 × 29mm Chime External Dimensions: 60 × 60 × 39.6mm Rated Input: 5V⎓1A Wireless Connectivity: RF 433MHz (receiving only) Operating Temperature: 0°C to 45°C Operating Humidity: 10%-90% RH, non-condensing WHAT’S IN THE BOX: Xiaomi Smart Doorbell 3S – Black x1 Mounting base × 1 Angle holder × 1 Chime × 1 Removal pin × 1 Type-C charging cable × 1 Screws bag (wall screw × 2, wall plug × 2, angle holder screw × 2) U-type extension wire × 2 Insulating cap × 2 U-type double terminal wire × 1 User manual × 1

item.title: DFRobot Gravity Digital 10A Relay Module – 3.3V / 5V Compatible, Arduino & Raspberry Pi Ready
item.description: DFRobot Gravity Digital 10A Relay Module – Technical Specifications: Module Type – Single Channel Digital Relay Module SKU – DFR0473 Brand – DFRobot (Gravity Series) Relay Coil Voltage – 3V DC Control Voltage Range – 2.8V to 5.5V DC Relay Rating (AC) – 10A @ 250V AC Relay Rating (DC) – 10A @ 30V DC Relay Contacts – NO (Normally Open) + NC (Normally Closed) + COM Relay Type – SPDT (Single Pole Double Throw) Trigger Type – High-Level Trigger (HIGH = Relay ON) Interface – Gravity 3-Pin (VCC, GND, SIG) Indicator LED – Onboard Status LED (ON when Relay Activated) Board Underside – Acrylic Insulation Plate (Safety Isolation) Mechanical Life – ≥ 100,000,000 Operations Operating Temperature – -40°C to +85°C Compatible Platforms – Arduino (5V), Raspberry Pi, ESP8266, ESP32, BeagleBone Black, mbed, Intel Joule (3.3V) Handy Tips for Using the DFRobot Gravity Digital 10A Relay Module: 1: This module is compatible with both 3.3V and 5V devices — not only Arduino boards but also Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone Black, mbed, and other 3.3V platforms. The wide input voltage range of 2.8V to 5.5V means it works reliably across virtually all common microcontroller and single-board computer platforms without needing a logic level shifter or additional components. DFRobot 2: The Gravity 3-pin interface (VCC, GND, SIG) is plug-and-play compatible with DFRobot's Gravity connector ecosystem — simply connect the Gravity cable between the module and your controller board's digital output pin. For non-Gravity boards, connect VCC to your 3.3V or 5V supply, GND to ground, and SIG to any digital GPIO pin. In Arduino code, digitalWrite(PIN, HIGH) activates the relay and digitalWrite(PIN, LOW) deactivates it. 3: The relay contacts include both Normally Open (NO) and Normally Closed (NC) terminals. For most switching applications — turning a device ON when the relay is triggered — connect your load between COM and NO . For applications where the load should be ON by default and switch OFF when triggered, use COM and NC instead. 4: The underside of the board is isolated using an acrylic plate for safety. This is an important feature when the module is mounted inside an enclosure alongside other PCBs — it prevents accidental short circuits from the relay's solder joints contacting conductive surfaces beneath the board. Always mount the module on standoffs or ensure adequate clearance regardless. 5: The relay is rated for up to 10A current, with mechanical parts guaranteed for up to 100 million uses. However, for continuous or inductive loads such as motors, pumps, and compressors, always derate to around 6–7A maximum for long-term reliability. Inductive loads generate voltage spikes when switched off — fitting a flyback diode or snubber circuit across the load protects the relay contacts from arcing and significantly extends service life.

item.title: TP-Link Tapo RV30 Max 5300Pa Hyper Suction Robot Vacuum & Mop
item.description: Say goodbye to tedious chores with the Tapo RV30 Max, a high-performance robot vacuum and mop designed to handle carpets, hard floors, debris, and pet hair — all with intelligent mapping and superior suction power. Boasting 5300 Pa maximum suction, the RV30 Max picks up even fine dust and deep grime, while the LiDAR + IMU dual navigation system maps your home accurately, avoids missing spots or repeating areas, and works reliably even in lower light. Mopping mode is fully featured: it includes an electric water-flow controlled mop with 3 levels of water flow, plus carpet avoidance to keep rugs dry. You get a 300 ml water tank and a matching 300 ml dustbin. With up to 150 minutes runtime per charge (on Quiet mode), auto-recharge & resume, and a climbing capability of ~22 mm to pass over common thresholds, this robot is built for many-room homes. It supports multi-floor mapping, virtual walls / no-go zones, zone & room-specific cleaning, and scheduling so you can tailor when and where it cleans. Noise levels are reasonable — around 52 dB in Quiet mode and about 55 dB in standard mode — so cleaning doesn’t disturb much. Controls are smart, too: voice-assistant support with Google & Alexa, real-time tracking via app, and child & pet lock features for safety. Features Ultra-Powerful 5300Pa Suction - Ensures the robot efficiently picks up dust, pet hair, crumbs, and various debris from all flooring surfaces, leaving your home spotless. LiDAR+IMU Dual Navigation System - Accurately maps out your house in minutes, avoids omissions and repeated cleaning, and even works well in the dark. No Spots Missed - Utilises Mesh Grid™ for a more comprehensive and thorough clean. Carpet Avoidance - Avoid getting carpet areas wet in mopping mode. Tapo IQ+ Smart Cleaning™ - Serves as the robot's brain. Powered by multiple sensors and advanced algorithms, you can reliably leave your home in its hands. Customizable Cleaning - Merge and separate areas, set a cleaning schedule, and customise clean modes for each room. 4× Multi-Floor Maps - Accurately detects different floors and creates 3+1 multi-floor local-stored maps to shape a full view of your house. Specifications The Tapo RV30 Max is a compelling option for those seeking a powerful and intelligent robot vacuum and mop without the added cost of an auto-empty dock (which is available in the RV30 Max Plus variant). Its LiDAR + IMU Dual Navigation system is a significant strength, allowing it to create highly accurate maps, navigate efficiently, and avoid repeating or missing areas. This translates to quicker and more systematic cleaning runs. What's in the Box Robot Vacuum Cleaner ×1 (Includes HEPA Filter x1 and Side Brush x1) Charging Dock ×1 Mopping Attachment ×1 Power Cord ×1 Cleaning Brush ×1 2 Year Warranty

item.title: TP-Link Tapo RV30 Max Plus Robot Mop & Vacuum + Smart Auto-Empty Dock
item.description: Meet the Tapo RV30 Max Plus—a high-performance robot vacuum and mop designed to make home cleaning automatic and effortless. It boasts an ultra-powerful 5300Pa suction for deep cleaning, a dual LiDAR + IMU navigation system for precise mapping and coverage, and a 3-litre auto-empty dock that holds debris for up to two months without needing manual intervention. It intelligently avoids carpet when mopping and features three water flow levels for customized cleaning on different hard floors. Users can set virtual walls and no-go zones in the companion app to keep the robot out of specific areas. It also works seamlessly with Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant for easy hands-free control, making it a powerful and convenient addition to any smart home. Features Ultra-Powerful 5300Pa Suction - Ensures the robot efficiently picks up dust, pet hair, crumbs, and various debris from all flooring surfaces, leaving your home spotless. Auto-Empty with 3L Large Dust Bag - Dust stays out of sight for up to 2 months with a disposable 3L large sealed dust bag. LiDAR+IMU Dual Navigation System - Accurately maps out your house in minutes, avoids omissions and repeated cleaning, and even works well in the dark. No Spots Missed - Utilizes Mesh Grid™ for a more comprehensive and thorough clean. Carpet Avoidance - Avoid getting carpet areas wet in mopping mode. Specifications The Tapo RV30 Max Plus offers an excellent balance of advanced features, powerful cleaning, and superb convenience for its price point. The inclusion of the auto-empty dock is a game-changer, allowing the robot to deposit collected dust and debris into a large 3L bag, providing up to 2 months of hands-free operation. This eliminates the daily chore of emptying the robot's small onboard dustbin. What's in the Box: Robot Vacuum Cleaner ×1 (Includes HEPA Filter x1and Side Brush x1) Auto-Empty Dock ×1(Includes 3L Disposable Dust Bag ×1and Cleaning Brush ×1) Mopping Attachment ×1 Power Cable ×1 User Manual 2 Year Warranty

item.title: Highlighter Dry
item.description: A dry highlighter has several advantages over a traditional highlighter, which uses a fiber-tipped pen to distribute wet ink. With dry versions, there is no bleeding or smearing, either of the highlighter ink itself or of the words underneath. The pen won’t dry out and you don’t have to wait for its lines to dry to write over the top of it or to close your book. Dry highlighters won’t leak in your backpack or purse or desk.

item.description: The Insta360 X5 is the ultimate 8K 360° action camera designed for creators who demand stunning detail and versatility. Capture immersive HDR 8K30 video with ultrasharp clarity using large 1/1.28" sensors powered by a Triple AI Chip and PureVideo for exceptional low-light performance. Shoot in dual-lens 360° mode or switch to single-lens wide-angle mode with up to 170° field of view for dynamic POV footage up to 4K60fps. Built tough for adventure, the X5 features user-replaceable scratch-resistant lenses, IP68 waterproofing to 15m (49ft), and a long-lasting 2400mAh battery with fast charging. Record with industry-leading stabilization, 360° horizon lock, and advanced audio including built-in wind guard for crisp sound in any environment. The innovative InstaFrame Mode lets you capture instant, share-ready flat video while simultaneously recording full 360° footage for flexible post-editing. Control the camera hands-free with voice, gesture, or remote, and rely on smart AI tools for seamless editing with the Insta360 app. Perfect for action sports, travel, and everyday vlogging, the Insta360 X5 redefines 360° filmmaking with professional-grade quality and all-day durability. item.title: Anycubic PETG-CF Satin Carbon Fiber Filament 1kg – Black
item.description: Carbon fibre reinforced PETG | Satin texture conceals layer lines | Superior impact and weather resistance | Easy to print The Anycubic PETG-CF Satin Carbon Fiber Filament is designed for FDM makers who need more than standard PETG can offer. Carbon fibre reinforcement delivers greater rigidity and impact resistance than regular PETG, allowing printed parts to handle high pressure and heavy loads without snapping. The carbon fibre infusion also conceals layer lines and imparts a refined satin texture with a subtle luster — well suited to vehicle parts, sci-fi models, and functional prototypes. Combining a fully-enclosed CoreXY printer with the ACE 2 Pro automatic colour-exchange system, this combo delivers a 350×350×350mm³ build volume alongside the capability to print in up to 16 colours in a single run. A Build Volume That Matches Your Ambitions Tired of splitting large models into multiple prints just to fit your build plate? The fully-enclosed CoreXY construction keeps the motion system rigid and precise across that entire volume, so dimensional accuracy doesn't suffer as your prints grow larger. Up to 16 Colours, Automatically Managed The ACE 2 Pro automatic colour exchange units included in this combo take multicolour FDM printing to a new level. With a maximum nozzle temperature of 350°C, you can print carbon-fibre composites such as PLA-CF and PETG-CF, flexible TPU, weather-resistant ASA, and tough ABS with confidence. The fully-enclosed chamber supports the stable thermal environment that engineering-grade and composite materials demand, giving you consistent results across a wide range of applications. item.title: Anycubic Kobra S1 Ace 2 Pro Combo 3D Printer
item.description: 16-colour multicolour FDM printing | Up to 600mm/s CoreXY speed | Fully enclosed with active filament drying | AI print monitoring | App and cloud control Quick Specs Print up to 16 colours simultaneously with the included ACE 2 Pro multi-material unit, expandable from a base of 4 colours Achieve blazing print speeds of up to 600mm/s on a rigid CoreXY motion system with 20000mm/s² acceleration Enjoy a generous 250mm × 250mm × 250mm build volume with fully automatic levelling — no Z-axis compensation needed Print with confidence using built-in AI spaghetti detection, filament runout sensing, and power-loss resume Control and monitor your prints from anywhere via the Anycubic App, AC Cloud, or the 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen Serious multicolour printing, straight out of the box The Anycubic Kobra S1 ACE 2 Pro Combo 3D printer is a fully enclosed CoreXY 3D printer bundled with the ACE 2 Pro multi-material unit, giving makers, hobbyists, and design professionals a complete system for producing vivid multicolour prints from day one. With a base capacity of 4 colours — expandable to 16 — and a 250mm × 250mm × 250mm build volume, it is built for anyone who wants more than a single-colour machine without building a separate setup from scratch. Speed and precision that keeps up with your creativity The Kobra S1 uses a CoreXY construction paired with light-rail X and Y axes, a dual-gear short-range extruder, and a maximum print speed of 600mm/s at up to 20000mm/s² acceleration. Layer thickness runs from 0.08mm to 0.28mm, giving you fine detail when you need it and fast rough drafts when you do not. The standard 0.4mm brass nozzle is quick-detachable and compatible with 0.2mm, 0.6mm, and 0.8mm alternatives, while the hotend reaches up to 320°C and the heated bed reaches up to 120°C — covering PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, and TPU with ease. Tired of failed prints ruining your filament and your day? The Kobra S1 ACE 2 Pro Combo 3D printer addresses the most common printing frustrations with a suite of intelligent safeguards. AI spaghetti detection monitors the chamber camera feed and can skip over problem areas before they ruin an entire job. Automatic filament detection and auto-resume handle runouts without manual intervention, and power-loss recovery picks up exactly where it left off after an unexpected outage. Fully automatic levelling with object-skip and area levelling means the printer arrives ready to print — no manual Z-axis compensation required. Keep filament dry and prints in perfect condition The ACE 2 Pro unit is more than a multi-material hub — it actively dries your filament during printing at temperatures up to 65°C, helping to prevent moisture-related print defects. A built-in temperature and humidity sensor monitors conditions inside the unit, while a solenoid valve expels moist air during the drying cycle. The enclosed chamber on the Kobra S1 itself houses an activated carbon air filtration system, keeping your workspace clean when printing with materials like ABS and ASA. Full control, wherever you are Manage every aspect of your print from the 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen on the machine, or connect over 2.4GHz Wi-Fi to use the Anycubic App, Anycubic Slicer Next, or AC Cloud for remote monitoring and control. A built-in chamber camera supports time-lapse photography so you can review print progress at a glance. The printer runs on Kobra OS, supports multilingual setup from first boot, and is compatible with both Anycubic Slicer Next and OrcaSlicer. Quiet mode keeps noise at or below 44dB — considerate for home studios and shared workspaces. item.title: Anycubic Ace 2 Pro - For Kobra X and S1/M
item.description: 4-channel active drying and feeding hub | Print-while-drying workflow | Brushless motors for quiet, reliable operation | Sealed moisture control | Compatible with Kobra X, S1, and S1 Max Quick Specs Dry and print simultaneously with active 65 °C drying — keep your filament fresh without pausing a single job Feed four colours at once through four independent brushless motors running at under 48 dB for smooth, near-silent operation Switch filaments faster with a next-generation buffer mechanism that doubles loading speed compared to the previous generation Protect every spool with sealed storage, an electromagnetic moisture valve, and real-time temperature and humidity monitoring Built to last with an alumina ceramic filament feeding port that resists wear far longer than standard plastic alternatives Upgrade Your Multi-Material Workflow The Anycubic ACE 2 Pro is designed for FDM makers who want a reliable, intelligent hub to manage multiple filaments — drying them, feeding them, and keeping them in peak condition, all at the same time. Compatible with the Kobra X, Kobra S1, and Kobra S1 Max, it connects seamlessly into your existing setup and replaces the guesswork of manual filament management with a fully automated system. Never Stop Printing to Dry Your Filament Again Tired of halting your print jobs just to run a separate drying cycle? The ACE 2 Pro supports simultaneous drying and printing, maintaining a chamber temperature of up to 65 °C while your printer keeps running. Built-in temperature and humidity sensors monitor conditions in real time, an electromagnetic valve actively expels moisture, and a silicone sealing ring blocks external humidity from creeping back in. Your filament stays as fresh as the day it came out of the bag. Faster, Quieter, More Reliable Feeding Four independent brushless motors — each rated for a lifespan of 5,000 hours or more — drive the next-generation buffer mechanism, delivering smooth and stable filament feed and retraction across all four channels. Operating at under 48 dB during closed-door printing, the ACE 2 Pro keeps your workspace quiet. Filament loading speed is doubled compared to the previous ACE Pro generation, meaning less waiting between colour changes and more time spent actually printing. The alumina ceramic filament feeding port adds another layer of durability, offering superior abrasion resistance over standard plastic ports for reduced long-term maintenance. Intelligent Monitoring and Jam-Free Maintenance The ACE 2 Pro keeps you informed and in control. Real-time temperature and humidity readings are displayed on the app, slicer, and printer screen. Filament runout detection and auto-resume printing mean unexpected interruptions are handled automatically. When a jam does occur, the quick-release external feeding channel and buffer mechanism allow rapid disassembly so you can clear the issue and get back to printing in seconds. Intelligent filament identification auto-detects Anycubic filament parameters when connected — eliminating manual profile configuration for supported materials. Big builds, serious speeds — without the compromise The Anycubic Kobra S1 Max 3D Printer is built for makers, engineers, and creators who need a large-format FDM 3D printer that can keep up with ambition. With a 350 × 350 × 350 mm³ build volume and a CoreXY motion system capable of reaching 600 mm/s (recommended 300 mm/s) at accelerations up to 20,000 mm/s², it handles everything from rapid prototyping to production-scale batch runs — without sacrificing print quality. Print more materials, solve harder problems Tired of a 3D printer that locks you into a handful of basic filaments? item.title: Anycubic PC Filament 1kg – Translucent White
item.description: Engineering-grade PC filament | High impact and heat resistance | Smooth, lustrous surface finish | 1kg spool The Anycubic PC Filament is an engineering-grade polycarbonate filament designed for makers and engineers who need parts that go beyond what standard PLA or ABS can offer. Compatible with FDM printers fitted with a nozzle of 0.2 mm or above, it prints at 270–290°C with a heated bed of 100–120°C, and supports print speeds of 40–250 mm/s. With a heat deflection temperature of 110°C and strong mechanical properties — including a tensile strength of 65±6 MPa and an Izod impact strength of 30±12 kJ/m² — it is well suited to structural parts, functional components, automotive applications, electronic housings, and outdoor use. The filament also delivers smooth model surfaces with a translucent, lustrous quality. Note that active drying is required before printing: 80°C for 8–12 hours. Supplied on a 1kg reusable spool with intelligent identification chip support for compatible Anycubic printers. item.title: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max 3D Printer
item.description: Massive 420 × 420 × 500 mm build volume | Speeds up to 600 mm/s | Precise auto-levelling | Wi-Fi, app and cloud control | Power-loss resume Quick Specs Print ambitious creations with a massive 420 mm × 420 mm × 500 mm build volume — room for truly large-scale single-piece prints Achieve faster results with print speeds of up to 600 mm/s, cutting waiting time without sacrificing quality Enjoy reliable first-layer adhesion every time thanks to precise auto-levelling and a PEI magnetic spring hotbed Stay in control from anywhere — manage prints via the Anycubic App, AC Cloud, or Anycubic Slicer Next over Wi-Fi Print with confidence knowing power-loss resume and filament runout detection protect your long prints from interruption Scale Up Your 3D Printing The Anycubic Kobra 3 Max is a large-format FDM 3D printer built for makers, designers, and hobbyists who are ready to stop thinking small. With a 420 mm × 420 mm × 500 mm build volume, it lets you produce genuinely large prints in a single run — from cosplay props and architectural models to functional prototypes and statement display pieces. Pair that with print speeds of up to 600 mm/s and you have a machine that matches ambition with efficiency. A Bed You Can Trust, Every Single Print Tired of spending more time levelling your bed than actually printing? The Kobra 3 Max takes that frustration away with its precise auto-levelling system, which probes the hotbed automatically and compensates for any surface variation before each print begins. The PEI magnetic spring board provides reliable adhesion during printing and releases finished parts cleanly once cooled, so you spend less time fussing and more time making. Intelligent Protection for Long Runs Long prints on a large machine deserve long-print protection. The Kobra 3 Max includes both power-loss resume and filament runout detection with auto resume. If the power cuts unexpectedly, the printer picks up exactly where it left off when you turn it back on. If your filament spool runs dry mid-print, it alerts you to reload and then continues — keeping hours of print time from going to waste. Connect, Slice, and Print Your Way The Kobra 3 Max gives you multiple ways to work. Slice models in Anycubic Slicer or Orca Slicer, send files via USB drive or over Wi-Fi through AC Cloud and Anycubic Slicer Next, and monitor and control print jobs remotely from your phone using the Anycubic App. The onboard touchscreen handles quick adjustments right at the machine, and a dedicated port for cameras and other peripherals is available for expanded monitoring. Supported filaments include PLA, TPU, PETG, and ABS, giving you genuine material flexibility within a single machine. Features Large 420 mm × 420 mm × 500 mm build volume for oversized single-piece prints FDM printing technology with a single 0.4 mm nozzle and layer thickness range of 0.08–0.28 mm Print speeds up to 600 mm/s for faster turnaround on large projects Precise auto-levelling system for consistent first-layer adhesion without manual adjustment PEI magnetic spring hotbed for reliable adhesion during printing and easy part removal after cooling Power-loss resume automatically continues a print after an unexpected power cut Filament runout detection with auto resume prevents failed prints due to empty spools Wi-Fi connectivity (2.4 GHz) with support for AC Cloud, Anycubic App, Anycubic Slicer Next, and USB drive printing Compatible with PLA, TPU, PETG, and ABS filaments Touchscreen control panel with multilingual support Camera and peripherals port available for optional video monitoring Dual metal spindles on Y-axis and lead screws on Z-axis for stable, accurate motion Specifications Printer Technology: FDM (Fused Deposition Modelling) Printing Volume: 420 mm (L) × 420 mm (W) × 500 mm (H) Print Layer Thickness: 0.08 - 0.28 mm Max Printing Speed: Up to 600 mm/s Supporting Filaments: PLA, TPU, PETG, ABS Nozzle Diameter: 0.4 mm Hotbed Material: PEI magnetic spring board Extrusion Type: Single Motion System Y-axis: Double metal spindles Motion System Z-axis: Lead screws Auto-Leveling: Auto-Level (Precise Auto-Leveling) Power Loss Resume: true Filament Detection and Auto Resume: true Control and Print Methods: Touchscreen, Anycubic App, Anycubic Slicer Next, U-Disk, AC Cloud Touchscreen: Yes (Touchscreen) Video Monitoring: Yes (Cameras and Other Peripherals port available) Multilingual Support: Yes Slicer Software: Anycubic Slicer, Orca Slicer Input File Formats: .STL,.OBJ,.3mf Output File Formats: G-code Connectivity: U-DISK, AC Cloud, Anycubic Slicer Next, Wi-Fi Wi-Fi Spec: 2.4G (2.400-2.4835GHz); item.title: Anycubic Kobra S1 FDM 3D Printer
item.description: Fully enclosed CoreXY speed | 250×250×250mm build volume | 320°C hotend | AI print monitoring | Ultra-quiet 44dB operation Quick Specs Print large, detailed models with a generous 250×250×250mm build volume inside a fully enclosed CoreXY chamber. Achieve fast, precise results with a recommended print speed of 300 mm/s and acceleration up to 10,000 mm/s². Enjoy ultra-quiet operation at as low as 44dB in Quiet mode — print overnight without disturbing the household. Tackle a wide range of materials including PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, and ASA with a 320°C capable hotend. Print with confidence thanks to AI Spaghetti Detection, filament runout sensing, and power loss recovery. Serious 3D Printing, Without the Fuss The Anycubic Kobra S1 is a fully enclosed CoreXY FDM 3D printer built for makers, hobbyists, and professionals who want fast, reliable results without constantly babysitting their machine. Powered by Kobra OS and packed with smart automation features, it brings high-speed printing, broad material compatibility, and intelligent print monitoring together in a single, capable package. Speed and Precision Locked In by CoreXY Tired of watching slow, lumbering printers grind through complex models? The Kobra S1's CoreXY construction, driven by linear rod motion on both X and Y axes and a single-motor three-pole Z-axis, delivers smooth, stable movement at a recommended 300 mm/s — with a maximum ceiling of 600 mm/s and up to 20,000 mm/s² acceleration. Pressure advance and flow calibration are built in, so what comes off the bed reflects what you designed, not what the printer could manage. A Hotend That Handles What You Throw at It With a maximum nozzle temperature of 320°C and a PEI spring steel heated bed reaching up to 120°C, the Kobra S1 supports a broad material roster — PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, and ASA — without requiring an upgrade. The standard 0.4mm nozzle handles everyday printing, while compatibility with 0.6mm and 0.8mm nozzles gives you flexibility for faster, rougher or more detail-focused work. The source material notes the hotend is designed for easy disassembly and clog-free performance. Smart Monitoring Keeps Your Prints Safe The Kobra S1 watches over every job so you don't have to. AI Spaghetti Detection spots failed prints early and can halt the job before filament becomes a tangled mess. Filament runout detection pauses the print and waits for you to reload, filament entanglement detection flags spool issues before they cause a failure, and power loss resume picks up exactly where it left off after an unexpected outage. A built-in HD camera supporting 480P video monitoring means you can check in remotely via the Anycubic APP over Wi-Fi. LeviQ3.0 auto-levelling and Z-Offset adjustment handle bed calibration automatically, and object-skip with area levelling adds further precision control. Quiet, Connected, and Easy to Control At as low as 44dB in Quiet mode, the Kobra S1 is considerate of its surroundings — a real advantage when printing long overnight jobs. The 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen gives you direct, responsive control on the printer itself, while slicing software, the Anycubic APP, and USB connectivity round out your options. The interface supports nine languages, making it accessible whether you're setting it up for the first time or handing it to a colleague. Features Fully enclosed CoreXY construction with a 250×250×250mm build volume for large, dimensionally accurate prints. Recommended print speed of 300 mm/s and maximum of 600 mm/s, with acceleration up to 20,000 mm/s². 320°C maximum nozzle temperature supports PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, and ASA filaments. Standard 0.4mm nozzle, expandable to 0.6mm or 0.8mm for versatile output options. PEI spring steel heated bed reaches up to 120°C for reliable adhesion across material types. LeviQ3.0 auto-levelling with Z-Offset and object-skip area levelling for consistent first layers. AI Spaghetti Detection, filament runout detection, filament entanglement detection, and power loss resume for worry-free printing. Built-in HD camera (480P) for remote monitoring via the Anycubic APP over Wi-Fi. Ultra-quiet operation at ≤44dB in Quiet mode and ≤46dB in Standard mode. 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen with nine-language support; controllable via printer, slicing software, Anycubic APP, or USB. Its enhanced toughness formula produces models that resist drops and impacts, flex without brittle fracture, and balance strength with ductility — making it well suited to action figures, consumer electronic shells, tooling fixtures, snap-on parts, and load-bearing structural components. A low-viscosity formulation promotes fast bubble dissipation and excellent resin flow, reproducing fine surface details and reducing overall print time. With a 4.3% volumetric shrinkage rate, the resin delivers superior dimensional accuracy and deformation resistance so your models come out true to design. The low-odour formulation keeps the printing environment comfortable, and broad compatibility with all 405nm UV-curing LCD/DLP printers means it slots into your existing workflow without fuss. Pre-configured profiles are available in Anycubic's Photon Workshop slicer, so you can achieve consistent, high-quality results from the very first print. item.description: Bring your finest ideas to life in breathtaking detail. The Anycubic Photon Mono M7 Pro is a next-generation resin 3D printer built for makers who refuse to compromise on quality. Instead of babysitting spool changes, load up to four filaments and let the system handle switching automatically, whether you're printing a single long job or a model that calls for several colours in one file. Climate-Aware Storage South African humidity is hard on hygroscopic filaments like PLA, PETG and nylon. The CFS's moisture-proof chambers include desiccant and real-time humidity and temperature monitoring in every compartment, so spools stay dry and print-ready between jobs rather than degrading on the shelf. Room to Grow One CFS unit covers four spools, but the system is designed to scale - link up to four units for a total of 16 spools, giving serious multi-colour projects or production workflows plenty of headroom without a full redesign of your setup. Features Automatic switching between up to 4 loaded filament spools. RFID-based spool identification for accurate material tracking. Filament run-out detection with automatic relay switching. item.title: Insta360 2-in-1 Invisible Selfie Stick + Tripod
item.description: Spec Value Compatible With Insta360 X-series, ONE series, GO series (via standard action camera mount) Function 2-in-1 invisible selfie stick and tripod Material Lightweight aluminium alloy telescoping shaft Extension Multi-stage telescoping for adjustable length Tripod Legs Built-in fold-out legs for freestanding use Invisible Effect Slim shaft profile disappears in 360° stitched footage when extended Mount Type Standard action camera thread/mount Handy Tips Extend fully for the true invisible effect — The stick's slim diameter is what allows Insta360's stitching algorithm to remove it from 360° footage. Partial extension or holding it at an angle can leave a visible shadow or blur line in the stitch zone. Switch to tripod mode for hands-free shots — Fold out the built-in legs on any flat, stable surface for time-lapses, livestreams, or group shots where you'd rather not hold the stick — no separate tripod needed. Mind the stitch line when panning — Even in invisible-stick mode, fast whip-pans or uneven terrain can momentarily reveal the shaft in the stitch seam. Smooth, steady movements keep the illusion consistent throughout a clip. Check tripod stability on uneven ground — The fold-out legs are designed for flat surfaces; on soft or sloped ground, weigh down the base or find firmer footing to avoid toppling during unattended recording. Collapse fully for storage — Retract the shaft completely and fold the legs flat before packing it away — this keeps the telescoping sections free of grit that could make future extension stiff or uneven.

item.title: eSun eTPU-95A Filament - 1.75mm - 1kg - Black
item.description: There are quite a range of unique types of 3D filaments on the market with strange and exciting properties and characteristics, although none are quite as fun as our 1kg spools of eSUN 1.75mm eFlex TPU. This filament, although designed with flexibility in mind, features a hardness rating of 95 Shore A, which is a lot harder than typical “Flexible” filaments. However, this level of hardness means that, instead of being flexible like the sole of a flip-flop, the flexibility is more focused on adding impact resistance and enhanced durability that PLA Filaments simply can’t achieve. This TPU is often regarded as a “Semi-Flexible” filament. However, despite this uniqueness, eSUN eTPU prints at similar specifications to standard PLA Filament. Just remember that with flexible filaments you need to apply slightly higher heat than usual, while running the print at a lower speed than most other 3D Filaments. This will prevent the filament from pulling off the lower layers while printing, resulting in great prints that are both durable and flexible. While you may certainly be able to print and polish this filament to a fine aesthetic finish, it won’t be able to reach the same level of beauty when compared to other filaments like the Silk Filaments. Typical TPE is designed with a high elongation and low hardness for high flexibility. Still, this semi-flex filaments is designed for engineering applications rather than aesthetics, with this particular shore hardness commonly being used for roller skates and skateboard wheels.

item.title: eSun PLA+ Filament - 1.75mm Black
item.description: 1kg of Black PLA+ eSUN Filament spooled and ready for use on 3D Printers with a 1.75mm Hotend Assembly . PLA+ filament is high quality, easy to use and bio-degradable. Now with extra additives for increased toughness, greater layer adhesion and less warping. DESCRIPTION PLA+ is a type of 3D printer filament that is based on standard PLA, but with extra additives to enhance a wide range of qualities. It addresses many of the common problems that PLA presents, such as the brittle nature, low elongation breaking point, as well as layer adhesion. The only area in which regular PLA beats PLA+ is in tensile strength, although it is a slight difference, and is far outweighed by the plethora of benefits. Advantages of PLA+ eSUN PLA+ is considered by many as the new standard for PLA printing, and despite being slightly more expensive than typical PLA, it offers far more value for money. It is not only easier to work with, but also produces better, smoother and less spider-webbed prints – while also being more flame resistant as well. In terms of the value that PLA+ brings to printing, it offers a wide variety of benefits, the first of which you will notice is far greater layer adhesion. This is due to the higher flow temperature, which will also help to produce less spider-webbing in gaps and less stringing along surfaces. Additionally, PLA+ has a lower distortion temperature, which means it is allowed a longer time to settle before it actually cools. This can be particularly beneficial for 3D printers without enclosures, and helps to ensure that each of the layers are printed before the previous layer starts warping or distorting – further improving on layer adhesion. While there are many other less predominant benefits, such being less brittle than PLA in filament form, the final key feature we will discuss is PLA+’s print finish quality. Owing to the enhanced layer adhesion, lower Melt Flow Index and higher stable print temperatures, PLA+ produces smoother, cleaner and more durable results. Whereas typical PLA is often brittle and can shatter quite easily, PLA+ has enough elongation and bending strength to resist falls, impacts and breaks from stretching. With these benefits in mind, it’s easy to see why so many Makers are choosing PLA+ as their favourite 3D printer filament.

Paper can be a flimsy and easily damaged material, and laminating pouches can help prevent this. Our laminating pouches range can keep your articles from getting creased or wrinkled, grazed, stained or smeared, or marked by grease or fingerprints; These kinds of damage are likely to occur if the documents pass through many hands during use. item.title: Creality Hyper ABS Filament Red
item.description: Creality Hyper ABS Filament Creality Hyper ABS is engineered for speed, strength, and reliability. Designed to push the limits of FDM printing, it combines high-speed performance with superior durability and reduced warping, making advanced 3D printing easier and more efficient. item.title: Insta360 Go Ultra Pivot Stand
item.description: The Insta360 Go Ultra Pivot Stand offers versatile positioning for your compact action camera, transforming how you capture hands-free content. This compact stand features a flexible ball-joint design that allows smooth 360-degree rotation and multi-angle tilting, giving you complete control over your camera's orientation. Whether you're setting up desktop shots, capturing creative angles on flat surfaces, or positioning your Go for time-lapses and POV content, the pivot mechanism locks securely into place while remaining easy to adjust on the fly. The stand's magnetic mounting system provides instant attachment and removal of your Insta360 Go, making it effortless to transition between handheld and stationary shooting. Its lightweight yet stable construction ensures your camera stays steady during recording, while the compact footprint makes it perfect for travel and tight spaces. The rubberized base prevents slipping on smooth surfaces, and the stand's low profile keeps your setup discreet when needed. Ideal for vloggers, content creators, and anyone looking to expand their shooting possibilities, this pivot stand maximizes the creative potential of your Insta360 Go Ultra with reliable, adjustable support wherever your content takes you.

item.title: Insta360 X5 Carry Case
item.description: The Insta360 X5 Carry Case is a compact, durable storage solution designed to protect your X5 camera and essential accessories on the go. Featuring a rigid, hard-shell exterior with a custom-molded interior, it securely houses the camera, spare batteries, fast charging case, cables, quick release mount, and even a selfie stick in the external side sleeve. The soft fabric exterior combines lightweight portability with style, while an internal mesh pocket offers extra space for small accessories. A fabric wrist strap on the outside ensures easy carrying, making it perfect for photographers and creators who need organized, reliable protection for their gear during travel or outdoor shoots.

item.title: Insta360 Mic Air Transmitter for X5/X4/AcePro
item.description: Experience professional-grade audio without the bulk with the Insta360 Mic Air Transmitter. This ultra-lightweight, coin-sized wireless microphone is designed for creators who need crystal-clear sound in any environment. Weighing just 7.9g, the Mic Air stays out of sight and out of the way, making it perfect for discreet vlogging, interviews, and on-the-go content. It delivers high-quality 48kHz/24-bit audio with advanced noise cancellation to filter out wind, crowds, and other distractions. For the ultimate convenience, the Mic Air connects directly to the Insta360 X5 and X4, Insta360 Ace Pro, and Insta360 Ace cameras without a separate receiver, allowing for a fast and seamless setup.

item.title: Insta360 Ace Pro 2 Clear Dive Case
item.description: Insta360 Ace Pro 2 Dive Case Take your underwater filming to deeper limits with the precision-engineered Insta360 Ace Pro 2 Dive Case. This transparent, heavy-duty housing provides a custom, secure fit that locks out the elements, shielding your camera from high-impact environments and extreme depths. item.description: eSUN PETG Basic Filament – Technical Specifications Plastic Type – PETG (Polyethylene Terephthalate Glycol) Plastic Diameter – 1.75mm ± 0.03 Density (g/cm³) – 1.27 Tensile Strength (MPa) – ~68 (X‑Y), ~36 (Z) Elongation at Break (%) – ~7.5 (X‑Y), ~3.2 (Z) Flexural Strength (MPa) – ~100 (X‑Y), ~60 (Z) Flexural Modulus (MPa) – ~2637 (X‑Y), ~2208 (Z) Impact Strength (kJ/m²) – ~2.3 (X‑Y), ~2.1 (Z) Heat Distortion Temperature (°C) – ~74 (0.45MPa) Filament Weight – 1kg spool Suggested Print Settings Nozzle Temperature (°C) – 240 to 260 Bed Temperature (°C) – 75 to 90 Nozzle Size – 0.2–0.8mm Print Speed (mm/s) – ≤250 (slightly slower for best finish) Cooling Fan – 50–100% Drying Recommendations – 60°C for >8 hours before use Build Surface – PEI recommended for adhesion Key Features Stronger than PLA, easier to print than ABS Glossy, clear surface finish Low shrinkage and minimal warping UV and moisture resistant – suitable for outdoor use Stable dimensions for reliable prints Good impact resistance and mechanical strength Applications Functional parts and housings Decorative items and lamps Containers and stationery Toys and hobby projects Outdoor applications requiring UV/moisture resistance Packaging Supplied on 1kg spool Vacuum‑sealed with desiccant for moisture protection Compatible with most FDM printers This filament is a versatile everyday PETG : tougher than PLA, easier than ABS, and ideal for both functional and decorative prints.

item.title: MG90S Servo Metal Gear Digital 180 Degree
item.description: Spec Value Component Type Digital micro servo motor, metal gear train Rotation Range 0–180° Operating Voltage 4.8V – 6V DC Torque ~1.8 kg·cm @ 4.8V, ~2.2 kg·cm @ 6V Speed ~0.1 sec/60° @ 4.8V Control Signal PWM, 50Hz, 1–2ms pulse width Gear Type All-metal gear train (upgraded from MG90's plastic/metal mix) Interface / Pinout 3-pin: Signal (orange/yellow), VCC (red), GND (brown/black) Weight ~13.4g Dimensions ~22.8 x 12.2 x 28.5mm Mounting Standard servo horn mounts (single/double arm, wheel) included Compatible With Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, RC receivers, any 5V PWM controller Typical Use RC cars/planes, robotic arms, camera pan-tilt mounts, small animatronics Handy Tips Power it separately from your microcontroller — Servos draw current spikes well beyond what an Arduino's 5V regulator or a dev board's USB power can supply, especially under load or when multiple servos move at once. Use a dedicated 5-6V supply (or a buck converter off a battery) and tie the grounds together, or you'll see brownouts and erratic resets. Center it before mounting the horn — Power the servo and send it a 1.5ms pulse (90°) before attaching the arm/horn, since MG90S units don't always start centered out of the box. Attaching the horn at the wrong position limits your usable travel range on one side. Add a flyback/decoupling capacitor — A 100-470µF capacitor across the servo's power leads smooths out the current spikes from the motor and gearbox, reducing signal noise that can cause jitter on the PWM line, especially with longer wires. Don't force it past its mechanical limit — Metal gears are stronger than plastic ones, but forcing the horn or sending PWM values outside ~500-2500µs can still strip the gear teeth or stall the motor; stay within the datasheet's pulse range unless you've confirmed wider travel experimentally. Watch the stall current under load — At 4.8-6V, stall current can spike to 500mA-1A momentarily; if you're running several servos off one supply rail, budget for worst-case stall current per servo, not just the idle/no-load draw, or your supply will sag. Check signal wire length and shielding — Long, unshielded signal wires can pick up noise from nearby motors or power lines, causing twitchy behavior. Keep signal runs short or add a series resistor (~1kΩ) near the microcontroller pin if you see jitter. Lubricate sparingly if reused from teardown — If this is a pulled/recycled unit, a small drop of light machine oil on the gear train (not the potentiometer) can quiet grinding noises, but avoid over-oiling near the internal pot, which can cause erratic position readings.

item.title: DC 12V Panel Mount Power Connector (Male & Female Pair) — 5.5mm x 2.1mm Barrel Jack/Plug Set
item.description: Spec Value Connector Type DC barrel jack (female, panel-mount) + matching DC barrel plug (male) Size 5.5mm OD x 2.1mm ID (standard barrel size) Polarity Center-positive (standard, verify before use) Rated Voltage Up to 12V DC (commonly rated higher, check datasheet) Rated Current Typically up to 5A Mounting Panel/chassis mount, threaded nut for enclosure wall installation Termination Solder tabs or screw terminals (varies by model) Material Nickel-plated brass contacts, plastic/metal housing Compatible With 12V power supplies, LED strips, amplifiers, project enclosures Typical Use Routing external DC power into an enclosure without soldering directly to internal wiring Handy Tips Confirm polarity before wiring — Most barrel connectors are center-positive, but not all are. Check the connector's markings or datasheet and test with a multimeter before connecting power, since wiring it backwards can damage downstream components. Match the plug and jack sizing exactly — 5.5mm x 2.1mm is the most common size, but 5.5mm x 2.5mm variants look nearly identical and won't seat properly (or will make poor contact). Always verify both connectors are the same size before assuming compatibility. Use the panel nut to seal against strain — The threaded panel mount isn't just cosmetic; tightening it properly secures the jack against the enclosure wall and reduces strain on the internal solder joints when the plug is inserted/removed repeatedly. Rate for your actual current draw — The "5A" rating is generic and varies by connector quality. For higher-current applications (e.g. powering motors or bright LED strips), check the specific connector's datasheet rating rather than assuming the standard figure applies. Strain-relieve the internal wiring — Since these connectors take the physical stress of repeated plug/unplug cycles, add a small zip-tie or hot glue strain relief on the internal wire connection to prevent the solder joint from cracking over time.

item.title: HW-070 PWM DC Motor Speed Controller / Voltage Regulator Module
item.description: None typical (bare board), some variants include power LED Mounting Mounting holes on PCB corners Compatible With DC motors, DC fans, LED strips (dimming), incandescent 12V/24V bulbs Typical Use Motor speed control, fan speed control, DC dimming, variable DC power tools Handy Tips Check current rating against your actual load — The "15A" rating printed on many HW-070 boards is a peak/short-burst figure achievable only with a heatsink and forced airflow; for continuous duty, budget well under that (often 5-8A) to avoid overheating the MOSFET. Add a heatsink for anything beyond light loads — The onboard MOSFET runs hot under sustained current, especially at lower PWM duty cycles where switching losses increase. A basic heatsink (even a small bolt-on aluminum one) meaningfully extends the module's safe operating range. Match input voltage to your motor's rating, not just the controller's max — The board tolerating up to 90V doesn't mean your motor does. Confirm the connected motor's voltage rating first, since PWM speed control assumes a compatible voltage motor, not a step-down regulator. Reverse polarity will likely damage it — Most HW-070 boards have no reverse-polarity protection. Double-check + and - on both the input and output screw terminals before applying power, since a wiring mistake can destroy the MOSFET instantly. Adjust the potentiometer gradually under load — Turning the pot fully clockwise/counterclockwise at power-on with a heavy motor load can cause a large inrush current spike. Start at low PWM duty cycle and ramp up once the motor is spinning, particularly for motors with high starting torque demand. PWM introduces electrical noise — Because it's a switching (not linear) regulator, expect some EMI/noise on the output line, which can interfere with nearby sensitive electronics (like audio circuits or precision sensors). Keep PWM wiring away from signal-sensitive cabling, and add a flyback diode across motor terminals if not already present on your motor. Not a true "voltage regulator" in the linear sense — Despite the common product naming, this module doesn't produce a fixed clean DC output; it delivers a PWM'd voltage whose average value changes with duty cycle. For loads needing genuinely smooth/regulated DC (not just motors/resistive loads), a linear or buck regulator is more appropriate.

item.title: WS2812 8-ch RGB LED driver
item.description: WS2812 8-Channel RGB LED Driver Module Spec Value Driver IC WS2812 (integrated LED + driver, or WS2812B breakout with 8 channels) LED Type Individually addressable RGB (WS2812/WS2812B) Channels 8 (8 independently controllable RGB LED outputs/pixels) Operating Voltage 5V DC Data Interface Single-wire digital (NZR communication protocol) Color Depth 24-bit (8-bit per R, G, B channel) Control Signal 800kHz single-wire data, cascadable (DIN/DOUT chaining) Current Draw Up to ~60mA per LED at full white brightness (plan power budget accordingly) Interface VCC, GND, DIN (and DOUT for daisy-chaining additional modules) Compatible With Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi (via FastLED, Adafruit NeoPixel, or similar libraries) Typical Use Addressable LED strips/rings, status indicators, ambient lighting, small LED matrix/pixel arrays Handy Tips Only one data pin controls all 8 channels — Unlike simple RGB LEDs needing 3+ PWM pins each, the WS2812's single-wire protocol lets you control all 8 (or hundreds) of LEDs from a single microcontroller GPIO pin, since color data is shifted through each LED in sequence. Timing is critical — The WS2812 protocol requires precise microsecond-level pulse timing to distinguish a "0" bit from a "1" bit. Use a dedicated library (FastLED, Adafruit NeoPixel) rather than bit-banging manually, especially on multitasking platforms like ESP32 where interrupts can disrupt timing and cause flickering or corrupted colors. Add a level shifter if running the MCU at 3.3V — Boards like ESP32 output 3.3V logic, but WS2812 expects a ~3.5V+ data signal when powered from 5V. It often works marginally without one, but a simple logic-level shifter (or a 74HCT125 buffer) on the DIN line significantly improves reliability, especially over longer wires. Budget your power supply for worst case — At full brightness/white, each LED can draw up to ~60mA. For 8 channels that's up to ~480mA just for the driver module; if you're chaining more LEDs downstream, calculate total current needs rather than powering everything off the microcontroller's 5V regulator. Add a decoupling capacitor and resistor — A ~1000µF capacitor across VCC/GND near the first LED smooths inrush current spikes, and a ~300-500Ω resistor in series on the DIN line reduces reflections/ringing on the data line — both commonly recommended to prevent the first LED in the chain from being damaged or corrupting data. DIN/DOUT direction matters — Data flows in one direction only (DIN in, DOUT out to the next device). Double-check the arrow/marking on the module before wiring a chain, since connecting backwards means the data signal won't propagate.
